items.title: Simultaneous local factorization of nonzerodivisors after a finite extension of a 1-dimensional Noetherian local ring
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file chow.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The statement asks for one finite extension A contained in B, with B/A killed by a power of the maximal ideal, over which several given nonzerodivisors a_1, ..., a_r simultaneously become unit multiples of a single local parameter at every maximal ideal of B. The proof reduces to r = 2 and then inducts on ell = min(length_A(A/a_1A), length_A(A/a_2A)): local solutions are first spread to A through the formal glueing lemma (chow.tex lines 681-693), A is then replaced by the blow-up ring of (a_1, a_2) built in lines 730-735 so that a_2 lies in (a_1), and the exponent m in a_2 = a_1^m c is shown to stay maximal under every further admissible finite extension by the discrete-valuation domination bound of lines 612-638. What is not routine is the termination step at lines 740-751: the pair must be rerun as (a_1, c), where one alternative is excluded by maximality of m and the other strictly decreases ell, so the induction closes only after combining the glueing, the blow-up and the boundedness input in that order.
